title: Escape velocity
references: Kleppner, D. and Kolenkow, R. J., An Introduction to Mechanics, 2nd ed., Cambridge University Press (2014)
validity_domain: Speed needed at distance r from the centre of a spherically symmetric, non-rotating mass M to reach infinity at rest, with no atmosphere and no other body.
limitations: Newtonian: not valid near a black hole
Ignores atmospheric drag, rotation of the body and the pull of other bodies
Speed at the instant of launch for a ballistic trajectory, not the speed a powered vehicle needs
